data.intro: Ask me to find services, products, contests and challenges, explain how the app works, or share general pet-care tips.
data.healthNotice: I’m not a vet. I can share general information, but I can’t diagnose or suggest medicine doses. In an emergency, contact a vet straight away.
data.privacy: Your chats are kept for 30 days so you can come back to them, and you can delete them at any time.
